lines.t: In the quiet, I hear your name
Through the chaos, you're the flame
A whisper soft, a thunder loud
You are all I need, yeah
You are the light that breaks my darkest hour You are all I need, yeah, who you are
My heart beats for your power
The mountains bow, the rivers sing To the one who holds everything
A love so vast it knows no end
You are all I need, yeah
You are the anchor when my world is wild
